graphic.text:
The Cisco Nexus 9336PQ ACI Spine Switch supports:
ACI fixed-spine design for low- and medium-scale ACI deployments
Connectivity for up to 36 Cisco Nexus 9300 leaf switches
High availability through redundant and hot-swappable power supplies and fans
Energy Efficiency through an optimized design

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9336PQ ACI Spine Switch is a 2-rack-unit (2RU) spine switch for Cisco ACI deployments that delivers 2.88 Tbps of bandwidth across 36 line rate 40 Gbps QSFP+ ports
